newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Jan-June shipbuilding orders surge.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Jan-June shipbuilding orders surge.

text.p: South Korean shipyards won orders totalling 5.28 million gross tons for 92 ships in the first half of this year, up from 1.94 million gross tons for 49 ships a year ago, shipbuilders said on Thursday.

The Korea Shipbuilders' Association said all ships were for export. The association said ships built in the six-month period totalled 3.24 million gross tons for 76 ships, against 3.89 million gross tons for 86 ships a year ago.
The backlogged orders at the end of June were 15.13 million gross tons (294 ships), compared with 11.908 million gross tons (270 ships) a year ago, the association said.
